59: Captured responses and counts: [evaluation-results.json](evaluation-results.json).
60: Fixtures are built from checked-out source slices plus explicitly synthetic claims.
61: Labels were specified before each live run; the second set adds a Chinese channel
62: task and new claim cases. It reuses candidate snippets, so it is not a statistically
63: independent production holdout or a calibration dataset.
64: 
65: | Measurement | Screensaver task | Chinese channel task |
66: | --- | ---: | ---: |
67: | Candidate excerpts retained | 4 / 12 | 2 / 12 |
68: | Labeled relevant excerpts retained | 3 / 3 | 1 / 1 |
69: | Original excerpt payload characters | 9,912 | 9,912 |
70: | Filtered excerpts characters | 3,114 | 1,682 |
71: | Entire rank report characters (including metadata) | 5,564 | 4,122 |
72: | Claim classifications matching labels | 11 / 12 | 8 / 8 |
73: | Wrongly accepted positive claims | 0 | 0 |
74: | Claims returned to Astra due to uncertainty | 3 | 1 |
75: | API requests (rank + audit) | 2 | 2 |
76: | Rank / audit elapsed milliseconds | 1183 / 1150 | 1228 / 1857 |
77: | API input tokens | 7,323 | 6,312 |
78: 
79: The four captured calls cost USD 0.00057267 according to API usage. Model returned
80: `typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917`. The initial audit had 12 model questions; the final policy
81: handles empty evidence mechanically, so the eight-case second audit uses seven.
82: Eleven candidate questions share one request in each run. These are measured small
83: batch results, not a claim of system-wide cost/latency savings or an Astra A/B comparison.
84: 
85: Rank reports reduced the candidate payload by 43.9% and 58.4%, including result metadata,
86: before instruction-loading overhead. First-use skill/reference loading can offset the
87: savings; use this for large/repeated ambiguous batches. Do not first read the entire
88: unfiltered input into Astra. No automatic pruning or blanket per-turn invocation.
89: 
90: One Chinese claim with absent device-test records was labeled `contradicts` rather
91: than `insufficient`; both map to inspect-evidence-gap, so there was no false completion.
92: Another Chinese case and the stale-evidence case correctly abstained under the unchanged
93: thresholds. Retained uncertain regression-test evidence was not discarded. This supports
94: advisory triage only, not calibrated accuracy, safe deletion or automatic approval.
95: The two hostile snippets did not override the rubric; this does not establish injection
96: resistance. Do not use this integration as a security boundary.
